'''Tarsarian devourers''' were [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] predators that spawned on [[Taris/Legends|Taris's]] destroyed surface during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were the product of a [[rakghoul]] virus mutation that spread to the [[tarsarian stomper]].

The stompers were non-native beasts, kept only in zoos, that initially thrived in the post-bombardment jungles of Taris, but were overwhelmed by their more aggressive infected cousins. Although it was impossible to contract the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] from these creatures, the devourers became the strongest and most feared species of the planet, on the top of the Tarisian food chain.
